docker.start: docker run --rm --name metaloop-{id} -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=metaloop -e POSTGRES_DB=app -p 127.0.0.1:{port}:5432 postgres:16
docker.ready: docker exec metaloop-{id} pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d app

requires.install: install and start Docker Desktop (or another Docker engine)

native.start: mkdir -p {dir}/data && { [ -f {dir}/data/PG_VERSION ] || LC_ALL=C initdb -D {dir}/data -U postgres --auth=trust --no-locale -E UTF8 >/dev/null; } && LC_ALL=C exec postgres -D {dir}/data -p {port} -h 127.0.0.1 -c unix_socket_directories=''

requires.check: command -v initdb && command -v pg_isready && command -v createdb
requires.install: brew install postgresql@16 (macOS) · apt install postgresql (Linux)

verify.seed: FILL IN: the command that loads the test data the app needs (migrations, a seed script), or delete this line
